description: Built-in generic report templates available to TemplateAgent.

templates.name: Document Analysis
templates.selection_hint: Use for PDF, text, Markdown, and document sources that need goal-driven analysis of subjects, claims, evidence, relationships, and limitations.

templates.name: Data Analysis
templates.selection_hint: Use for CSV, TSV, Excel, Parquet, and JSON tables that need goal-driven patterns, comparisons, relationships, anomalies, and limitations.

templates.name: Executive Overview
templates.selection_hint: Use for concise management reports that prioritize KPIs, movement over time, drivers, and actions.

templates.name: Time-series Analysis
templates.selection_hint: Use when the report goal centers on how one or more measures change over an ordered time dimension.

templates.name: Segment Comparison
templates.selection_hint: Use when the report compares categories, cohorts, regions, products, or other business segments.
